title: A new half-sandwich Yb(II) complex with the tridentate cyclopentadienyl ligand [C5H4CH2CH(O)CH2OBun]2-: synthesis, self-assembly of a tetranuclear cubane-like framework {[(η5-C5H4)CH2CH(μ3-η1-O)CH2OBun]Yb}4 and oxidative alkylation by Me2Hg to the Yb(III) derivative [(η5-C5H4)CH2CH(η1-O)CH2OBun]YbMe(THF)

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: tetranuclear Yb(II) half-sandwich cubane complex {[(η5-C5H4)CH2CH(μ3-η1-O)CH2OBun]Yb}4 (THF solvate)

synthesis.procedure: Under vacuum using standard Schlenk techniques, a solution of 2.0 g (10.3 mmol) of ligand 3 (racemic 3-cyclopentadienyl-1-butoxy-2-propanol) in 25 mL of THF was added slowly under vigorous stirring to a suspension of 4.7 g (10.6 mmol) of C10H8Yb(THF)n (complex 4) in 60 mL of THF. The mixture turned red, the residue dissolved, and H2 was evolved. After 6 h the solution was filtered, THF was removed under vacuum, and the red residue was extracted with hexane to separate naphthalene (1.22 g, 90%). The red solid was redissolved in 25 mL of THF and 20 mL of hexane was slowly added at room temperature to afford a reddish-brown oil. Long cooling (1 month, -5 °C) of the oil in the mother liquor gave dark red crystals of 1.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature for the substitution; crystallization at -5 °C
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk techniques under vacuum; filtration and hexane extraction
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtration, vacuum removal of THF, hexane extraction of naphthalene, redissolution in THF, addition of hexane to give an oil, and long cooling at -5 °C to afford dark red crystals.

synthesis.procedure: To a solution of 1.8 g (1.17 mmol) of cluster 1 in 45 mL of THF was added 0.54 g (2.33 mmol) of dimethylmercury. The mixture was refluxed for 60 h at 60 °C and turned brownish-yellow. The solution was decanted from metallic mercury (0.46 g, 98%). Slow diffusion of hexane vapor into the THF solution yielded 2 as a light-brown microcrystalline solid.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: reflux in THF under Schlenk/vacuum conditions; decantation from Hg
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Decant from metallic mercury; slow diffusion of hexane vapor into the THF solution to give a light-brown microcrystalline solid.
